title: massachsuets — Weather All in One — Boston — today
description:
Boston weather opens this Massachusetts daily update for October 7, 2026, followed by a Blackstone business story and a closer look at household costs. Coldstuff Ice Cream owners say a customer mistreated a teenage employee, and they defended their staff. We compare Boston-area regular gasoline with last October, show Boston's median home sale price for the three months ending in August, and explain Massachusetts unemployment and national grocery inflation. The key distinction: slower grocery inflation still means higher prices. Figures come from the supplied weather report, AAA, Redfin and BLS; the staff account was
